; ghostbuster-page.qmd
; Automatically clear ghosting on page turns, link clicks, dialog closes, and toolbar toggles
; Optimized with single settle timer and cooldown rate-limiting to prevent double refreshes

AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&6503679477&~ pageRefreshPending: ~&214625660372&~
            property ~&7082585429636&~ lastFullClearTime: 0

            function triggerSafePageClear(~&7083120765809&~) {
                ~&197102514&~ now = ~&6502586279&~.now();
                ~&5972376&~ (now - lastFullClearTime < 1200) {
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }
                lastFullClearTime = now;
                ~&482865290967253827&~.~&8021204117616398611&~(~&7083120765809&~);
            }

            function onPageTurn() {
                pageRefreshPending = ~&6504329801&~;
                ~&5972376&~ (!~&6504254477&~.~&254534022647302435&~) {
                    pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&7713147298280334&~ = 350;
                    pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                } ~&6503784146&~ {
                    pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&6504295855&~();
                }
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: pageTurnGhostBusterTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 350
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.pageRefreshPending) {
                        ~&5972376&~ (!~&6504254477&~.~&254534022647302435&~) {
                            ~&6504254477&~.pageRefreshPending = ~&214625660372&~;
                            triggerSafePageClear("Page change");
                        } ~&6503784146&~ {
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&7713147298280334&~ = 150;
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            ~&428051690305612204&~ {
                ~&7083194890448&~: ~&6504254477&~
                function onIsLoadingChanged() {
                    ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.pageRefreshPending) {
                        ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.~&254534022647302435&~) {
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&6504295855&~();
                        } ~&6503784146&~ {
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&7713147298280334&~ = 250;
                            pageTurnGhostBusterTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: dialogGhostBusterTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 200
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    triggerSafePageClear("UI close");
                }
            }

            ~&428051690305612204&~ {
                ~&7083194890448&~: ~&233745975898428&~
                function onShownChanged() {
                    dialogGhostBusterTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                }
                function ~&2815617667007525497&~() {
                    dialogGhostBusterTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                }
            }
        }

        REBUILD [[2104365313657427216]]
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM \~&16435552976362715847&~.~&233743006639214&~();\ INSERT STREAM \ onPageTurn();\
        END REBUILD

        REPLACE [[9859199064309061864]] WITH {
            function ~&9859199064309061864&~(~&254534035348688339&~) {
                ~&5972376&~ (~&254534035348688339&~) {
                    ~&482865290967253827&~.~&8400213107195236010&~(~&433854763438791459&~.~&7854348604917286446&~);
                } ~&6503784146&~ {
                    ~&482865290967253827&~.~&8400213107195236010&~(~&433854763438791459&~.~&7854348604443282861&~);
                    dialogGhostBusterTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
